summary: A genuine coin flip that comes down to which weather sticks. Swampert's Ice Punch is an unconditional 4x hit on Garchomp, but Sun's mirroring 4x answer only fires instantly while sun — not rain — is the active weather.
keyFactors: Swampert's Ice Punch is 4x effective against Garchomp (Dragon/Ground is one of the game's most well-known double weaknesses) — no weather dependency, it just works.
Charizard's Solar Beam is a mirroring 4x hit on Swampert (Water/Ground both weak to Grass), but only skips its charge-up turn while sun is the active weather, which rain directly fights against.
Garchomp's Earthquake does nothing to Pelipper (Flying is immune to Ground moves), taking Sun's most reliable physical attacker out of that specific exchange.
Whichever side wins the 'last weather set' race effectively decides several of these exchanges — a genuinely close, execution-dependent matchup.
